mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate to near-zero levels compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that triggers immediate market pessimism, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based demand collapse, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a deepening economic contraction without immediate policy relief.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 5% from their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a pandemic-induced supply shock, a decline in industrial production below its 3-month moving average signals worsening supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates prolonged economic dislocation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during the pandemic supply shock when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate falls below 1.5%, it signals deflationary risks that limit the Federal Reserve's ability to stimulate the economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors fear a liquidity trap.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in non-farm payrolls indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which consistently generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market discounts worsening economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a decline in real GDP growth (as measured by the quarterly GDPC1 level) signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged economic hardship.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of recession periods when GDPC1 declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 1.5%) and near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals a deflationary liquidity trap, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market perceives limited policy options to stimulate the economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.
